verdict.rationale: Secureframe documents a native risk register that can be seeded from a NIST risk library. Comply AI for Risk produces inherent risk scores, treatment plans, residual risk scores and justifications, and risks are exposed as data objects via the MCP server. That covers scored risks with treatments, but the docs never show per-risk owners, recurring review cycles for the register, or risk-to-control mapping. Missing for 10: documented risk owners, scheduled risk review cycles, risk-to-control linkage, independent or hands-on corroboration.
